jobs.title: Apprentice (Store Operations)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Apply for Starbucks Apprentice 2027 across multiple locations in India. Paid on-the-job training for graduates & postgraduates with certificate. Apply now!

New Delhi: Tata Starbucks Private Limited has opened online applications for the Starbucks Apprentice 2027 program across multiple locations in India. Listed on the official Starbucks India Careers portal, this structured on-the-job training initiative invites freshers, graduates, and postgraduates to build hands-on retail, customer service, and store operations expertise.

For Indian students and recent graduates looking to start their careers with a globally recognized brand, the Starbucks Apprentice 2027 program offers a 5-day work week, practical mentorship, and a government-recognized and Starbucks co-branded certificate upon completion.

About Tata Starbucks Private Limited

Starbucks India operates as a 50:50 joint venture between Tata Consumer Products and Starbucks Corporation, managing over 500 stores across 80+ Indian cities. Known for its people-first culture—where employees are referred to as “partners”—Tata Starbucks emphasizes ethical leadership, hospitality, and community connection.

Completing an apprenticeship with Tata Starbucks gives freshers real-world exposure to high-volume retail operations and customer engagement while earning a nationally recognized credential.

Starbucks Apprentice 2027: Key Highlights

FeatureOfficial Details
OrganizationTata Starbucks Private Limited
Role TitleApprentice (Store Operations)
Job LocationsMultiple Cities Across India (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Gurugram, etc.)
Eligible CandidatesFreshers (12th/Diploma, Graduate & Post Graduate students)
Program Duration12 Months (for Graduates/PG) / 6 Months (for 12th/Diploma)
Work Schedule5 days working per week (9 hours/day including a 1-hour break)
CertificationGovernment-recognized & Starbucks co-branded certificate
Application ModeOnline via Official Starbucks Careers Portal

Role Details and Scope of Training

The Starbucks Apprentice 2027 program is an on-the-job training track designed to help freshers achieve nationally recognized industry standards. Selected apprentices gain practical training in:

  • Customer Experience & Hospitality: Delivering prompt, welcoming service and crafting quality beverages and food items.
  • Store Operations & Hygiene: Maintaining a clean, safe, and comfortable store environment aligned with Tata Starbucks guidelines.
  • Workplace & Interpersonal Skills: Developing strong communication, teamwork, professionalism, and corporate work ethics.
  • Final Assessment: Completing an online assessment at the end of the apprenticeship tenure to qualify for certification.

Eligibility Criteria and Mandatory Conditions

Before applying on the official Starbucks Careers portal, confirm that you meet every mandatory requirement:

Educational & Age Qualifications

  • Fresher Status: Only freshers are eligible to apply; no prior corporate or retail work experience is required.
  • Minimum Age: Applicants must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Academic Qualification:
    • 12 Months Apprenticeship: Graduation (or Post Graduation) in any discipline from a recognized university.
    • 6 Months Apprenticeship: 12th Pass or Diploma holders are also eligible under the shorter track.

Mandatory Document & Schedule Requirements

  • Valid Aadhaar Card: A valid Aadhaar (National Identity) card and Aadhaar-linked personal bank account are mandatory for apprenticeship registration.
  • Shift Availability: Ability to work 9 hours per day (including a 1-hour break) for 5 days a week across variable store shifts.

Stipend and Apprentice Benefits

While exact stipend figures vary by city and apprenticeship track on individual store listings (typically benchmarked under national apprenticeship norms), Tata Starbucks provides comprehensive partner benefits:

  • Paid On-the-Job Training: Monthly stipend paid throughout the 6-month or 12-month tenure.
  • Dual-Recognized Certificate: Receive a government-recognized and Starbucks co-branded certificate upon passing the final online assessment.
  • 5-Day Work Week: Tata Starbucks was the first QSR brand in India to implement a 5-day work week for store partners.
  • Partner Perks & Career Progression: Access to free daily beverages/food during shifts, 30% in-store partner discounts, and opportunities to grow into full-time Barista or Shift Supervisor roles after completing the program.

How to Apply for Starbucks Apprentice 2027 (Step-by-Step)

Follow these steps to apply online through the official Tata Starbucks recruitment portal:

  1. Visit the Official Careers Portal: Go to the Starbucks India Careers Portal (or open the direct Starbucks Apprentice Job Listing).
  2. Search Your Preferred Location: Filter open Apprentice positions by your preferred city (such as New Delhi, Gurugram, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, or Pune).
  3. Create a Candidate Profile: Click Apply Now, sign up with your email ID, and complete your personal profile.
  4. Upload Documents: Attach your updated resume, educational mark sheets, and Aadhaar verification details.
  5. Submit Application: Review all entered details carefully and submit your application.

Official Apply Link for Starbucks Apprentice 2027 – https://careers.starbucks.in/job/Delhi-Apprentice/580120210/

Starbucks India Official Careers Website – https://careers.starbucks.in/
